claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: NBQX is a selective AMPA/kainate glutamate receptor antagonist with no reported cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.
